Hi! I\'m in a meeting and can\'t answer. I\'ll call you back around {time+1}, or write me here 👍
Hi! I\'m riding and can\'t answer 🏍️ Write me here, I\'ll reply as soon as I stop.
Hi! We\'re closed right now. Tell me here what you need and I\'ll reply {tomorrow} morning 🙂
⭐ = default message. During the call you can pick another one.
Tap to insert: they fill in when sending
Outside working hours a different message is used automatically.
Saturday and Sunday are out of hours
Working, but may stop when closed
Works even when the app is closed
Call2Chat works even when closed. When a number not in your contacts calls, the Send card appears over the call.
You skipped some steps: the app may not alert you when closed. Finish them any time by tapping the card at the top.
Tip: open recent apps, long-press Call2Chat and tap the lock 🔒 so it isn\'t closed.
Choose Call2Chat as «Caller ID & spam app». Android will only tell it about numbers not in your contacts.\n\nIt never blocks, records or listens to calls.
Needed to alert you with the ready message when someone calls.
Turn on «Display over other apps» for Call2Chat: while the phone rings, the Send on WhatsApp card appears.
Turn off «Pause app activity if unused» (or «Remove permissions if app isn\'t used»). Otherwise Android stops it after a few weeks.
Open «Battery» and choose «Unrestricted». This way Call2Chat alerts you even when closed.\n\nThen come back and tap Done.

Turn on:
• Autostart
• Display pop-up windows while running in the background
• Show on lock screen

Then come back and tap Done.

In «Battery» choose «Unrestricted».

If Call2Chat is among «Sleeping apps» (Device care → Battery → Background usage limits), remove it.

Then come back and tap Done.
Turn on «Auto launch» (or «Allow background activity») for Call2Chat.\n\nThen come back and tap Done.
Allow Call2Chat to auto-start and run in the background.\n\nThen come back and tap Done.
In «App launch» set Call2Chat to «Manage manually» and turn on all three switches.\n\nThen come back and tap Done.
